Name: Khách hàng 1
SqlColumnQuery: select dbo.TCVN2Unicode(TenTruong) as 'ColumnName',dbo.TCVN2Unicode(TenTruong) as 'DisplayName', dbo.TCVN2Unicode(KieuDuLieu) as 'DataType' from DM_RunSQLGrd where Ma ='{Name}'

Name: A Hùng
SqlLogin: select Key1 as UserKey,dbo.TCVN2Unicode(ten) as UserName,MatKhau as Password,Ghi_Chu as Note from Users where ten = @username and MatKhau= @password
SqlReport: select Ma as 'Name', dbo.TCVN2Unicode(Ten) as 'FullName',NhomBC as 'Group',SQL1 as 'SqlQuery'  from SysReport
SqlColumnQuery: select dbo.TCVN2Unicode(TenTruong) as 'ColumnName',dbo.TCVN2Unicode(TenTruong) as 'DisplayName', dbo.TCVN2Unicode(KieuDuLieu) as 'DataType' from DM_RunSQLGrd where Ma ='{Name}'

Name: Khách hàng 2
SqlLogin: select pid as UserKey,username as UserName,ten as FullName,password as Password,'' as Note from app_users left join dmnhanvien on app_users.MaNV = dmnhanvien.ma where username = @username and password= @password
SqlReport: select ma 'Name',hienthi 'FullName',b.tennhom 'Group',sqlhienthi 'SqlQuery' from app_chucnang a join app_reportgroup b on a.rptgroup = b.id where isnull(rptgroup,0) > 0
SqlParameter: select  a.rptname as 'Name',parname as 'Param',a.hienthi as 'ParamName',b.sqlhienthi as 'SqlQuery',b.cotgiatri as 'ColumnValue',b.cothienthi as 'ColumnDisplay' from app_thamsobaocao a left join app_chucnang on a.rptname = app_chucnang.ma full join app_chucnang b on a.sqlname = b.ma where rptname = @Name
SqlColumnQuery: select doituong as 'ColumnName',hienthi as 'DisplayName', kieudl as 'DataType',cotrong as 'ColumnWidth' from app_ctchucnang where chucnang = @Name
